Start your career as a reach truck driver in Eindhoven! Enjoy day shifts, a competitive salary, and develop yourself in a modern workplace. 
 Over het werk 
As a reach truck driver, you are an essential part of the logistics process. You work full-time in day shifts, from 06:30 to 15:15. There are plenty of opportunities to develop yourself, such as obtaining your reach truck and stacker certificate if you don't already have them. This position starts with a seven-month contract through Luba, with the prospect of a permanent position upon good performance. You'll work in an inspiring and modern environment that offers many possibilities for personal growth. 
You start your working day by checking the received goods. Then you get to work picking and preparing materials for production orders. Using a reach truck and stacker, you make sure everything ends up in the right place. You pack orders, keep the warehouse tidy, and organize the inventory. During your day, you identify opportunities for improvement and share your ideas directly with your supervisor, actively contributing to a more efficient warehouse. 
Are you accurate, flexible, and do you like to get things done? Then apply quickly as a warehouse employee logistics! You will work in an ambitious team and get the chance to contribute daily to the growth of an innovative organization. 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - Salary between € 2,825 and € 2,914 per month - Day shifts with fixed working hours - 25 vacation days and holiday pay - Travel allowance 0.23 per km and free lunch - Initial contract through Luba (7 months) with the prospect of a permanent position 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - In possession of a reach truck certificate - Experience in a logistics or warehouse role - Good command of the English language (Dutch is a plus) - Flexible attitude and accurate working method
